usage: agentware team register [-h] [--format {text,json}] --name NAME
                               [--handle HANDLE] [--no-set-default]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --name NAME           existing team name
  --handle HANDLE       caller handle
  --no-set-default      do NOT persist AGENTWARE_TEAM/ORG_ROOT to config
